blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Autoformalization (AF) requires more than compilation: formal statements must preserve the meaning of their informal sources, a property known as faithfulness. An emerging frontier is the automated evaluation of this property, yet most existing methods operate at the statement level and produce whole-item verdicts, failing to reveal how individual expressions correspond or which contextual interpretations support the judgment. This omission is consequential because AF is inherently theory-scale: target statements derive their meaning from surrounding mathematical material and unstated conventions. We formulate faithfulness evaluation as a context-aware align-then-label problem: identifying phrase-level correspondences between informal and formal statements and assigning a faithfulness label to each under explicitly specified contextual interpretations and assumptions. We also introduce FaithAlign, the first theory-scale faithfulness benchmark comprising 460 items and 4,982 annotated phrase-level links, alongside FaithAlign-Gap, a companion set of 146 items with informal context and assumptions withheld. Each FaithAlign item includes the target statement pair, relevant context, formal dependencies, and, where needed, assumptions specifying one given interpretation. Across 8 models, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest defect F1 at 47.8% and identifies all defects in only 4.5% of items with two or more defects. On FaithAlign-Gap, Astra identifies only 28.2% of undecidable items as such. These results show the difficulty of recovering context-dependent correspondences, establishing FaithAlign as a testbed for fine-grained, context-aware faithfulness evaluation.
blocks.zh: 自动形式化(AF)不仅仅需要汇编:正式声明必须保留其非正式来源的含义,这种财产被称为忠诚. 一个新出现的前沿是对这种属性进行自动评估,然而,大多数现有方法都在语句层面运作并产生整个项目的判决,未能揭示个人表达方式如何对应或哪些背景解释支持判断。 这种省略是必然的,因为AF是内在的理论尺度:目标声明从周围的数学材料和未声明的公约中得出其意义. 我们将忠实评价作为了解背景的校正和标签问题:确定非正式声明和正式声明之间的短语级对应关系,并在明确规定的背景解释和假设下为每一项声明指定忠实标签。 我们还介绍了FaithAlign,这是第一个理论规模的忠诚度基准,包括460个项目和4 982个附加说明的短语级链接,以及FaithAlign-Gap,这是一套由146个项目组成的配套组合,不附带非正式上下文和假设。 每个FaithAlign项目包括目标语句配对,相关上下文,形式依赖性,以及必要时指定一个给定解释的假设. 在8个模型中,GPT-6 Astra以47.8%的成绩实现了最高的缺陷F1,并在只有4.5%的有2个或2个以上缺陷的物品中识别出所有缺陷. 在FaithAlign-Gap上,Astra只识别出28.2%的不可识别项目是这样. 这些结果表明,很难恢复依赖上下文的函证,将FaithAlign确立为精细而了解上下文的忠诚评价的测试床.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Autoformalization aims to translate mathematical writing into formal statements and definitions while preserving its meaning—a property known as faithfulness .
This task is theory-scale : formalizing a mathematical definition requires tracing its dependencies on other definitions, standing assumptions, and conventions ( Min et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026 ) .
A formalization may look faithful in isolation but narrow the domain, omit an assumption, or misstate a definition in its original context, causing cascading failures in theory-scale autoformalization.
Assessing faithfulness therefore requires identifying each discrepancy and tracing the dependencies behind it.
When context is missing, the available information may support different interpretations.
In such cases, faithfulness is undecidable .
blocks.zh:
自动形式化旨在将数学写作转化为正式声明和定义,同时保留其意义——一种被称作"忠诚"的财产.
这项任务是理论尺度:将数学定义正规化,需要追踪对其他定义、常态假设和公约的依赖性(Min等,2026;Feng等,2026)。
形式化可能在孤立中看起来是忠实的,但缩小了范畴,省略了一种假设,或者在原来的上下文中错误地表述了一种定义,导致理论规模自形式化的连锁失败.
因此,评估忠诚度需要查明每一种差异并追踪其背后的依赖性。
在缺少上下文时,现有信息可能支持不同的解释。
在这种情况下,忠诚是无法确定的。

blocks.en:
Existing evaluations largely reduce faithfulness to a scalar score or binary verdict for a pair of informal and formal statements ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Poiroux et al., 2025 ; Patel et al., 2026 ) .
Such outputs do not map the surrounding informal context to formal dependencies or show whether all defects have been localized.
AriaScorer grounds binary judgments in retrieved library definitions but does not measure coverage of contextual correspondences ( Wang et al., 2026a ) .
FormalRx localizes problematic formal code without linking it to informal expressions and their dependencies ( Wang et al., 2026b ) .
The binary labels used by MA-Align and FormalRx cannot represent undecidable cases where context is underspecified ( Patel et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) .
A definite verdict thus assumes an interpretation unsupported by the supplied material.
blocks.zh:
对一对非正式和正式声明,现有评价在很大程度上将忠诚度降低为分数或二进制(Lu等,2025;Poiroux等,2025;Patel等,2026)。
这种产出没有将周围的非正式背景映射到正式的依赖性,也没有显示所有缺陷是否都已本地化。
AriaScoreer在检索的图书馆定义中基于二进制判断,但不衡量背景通信的覆盖范围(Wang等,2026a.).
正式 Rx将有问题的正式代码本地化,而不将其与非正式表达及其依赖性联系起来(Wang等,2026b.).
MA-Align和AtroleRx使用的二进制标签不能代表上下文描述不足的不可识别案例(Patel等,2026;Wang等,2026b.).
因此,作出明确判决的前提是提供的材料不能支持解释。

blocks.en:
We introduce a novel context-aware align-then-label problem to address these gaps.
Each input includes an informal target, its source context and assumptions, a formal target in Lean, and relevant formal dependencies.
The model links aligned regions on the informal and formal sides and then labels each link’s faithfulness.
This measures whether the model locates the mathematical content behind each defect and judges it correctly.
By making individual correspondences explicit, align-then-label makes the model’s judgments traceable and supports systematic analysis of errors.
blocks.zh:
我们提出一个新颖的背景认识问题,以弥补这些差距。
每项投入包括一个非正式目标、其来源背景和假设、Lean的正式目标以及相关的正式依赖。
该模式将非正式和正式方面的区域连接起来,然后标出每个链接的忠诚。
以此衡量模型是否定位每个缺陷背后的数学内容并正确判断.
使个别的公文明确、一致和贴上标签使模型的判断可以追踪并支持对错误的系统分析。

blocks.en:
We introduce FaithAlign, a heterogeneous benchmark with 460 items and 4,982 annotated alignment links built from five mathematical formalization sources.
The sources vary in alignment density and structure, while the links range from multi-span correspondences to regions with no counterpart, with 25.5% involving context or assumptions.
The annotations distinguish defects such as missing conditions from benign informal commentary that need not appear in the formal statement.
We also introduce FaithAlign-Gap, a 146-item companion set that withholds informal context and assumptions.
Of these items, 85 become undecidable and 61 remain decidable, testing whether models recognize when a faithfulness judgment depends on missing information.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了FaithAlign, 由5个数学形式化来源构建的由460个项目和4 982个附加注释的对齐链接组成的不同基准。
来源在对齐密度和结构上各有不同,而链接范围从多波段通信到没有对应区域,其中25.5%涉及上下文或假设。
说明区分了缺失条件等缺陷和不需要在正式声明中出现的良性非正式评注。
我们还介绍了FaithAlign-Gap,这是一套146项的配套软件,不采用非正式的背景和假设。
在这些项目中,85项变得不可判定,61项仍然不可判定,检验模型是否承认忠诚判断取决于缺失的信息.

blocks.en:
Evaluation of 8 models reveals frequent failures to identify the complete set of defects.
GPT-6 Astra, the strongest model on defect F1, scores only 47.8% and identifies every defect in only 34.3% of defective items.
It fails to align 68.6% of defective context links.
Models also tend to produce coarser alignments than humans, merging distinct mathematical objects and missing crucial correspondences.
When informal context and assumptions are withheld, the best model recognizes only 28.2% of undecidable items: models often give definite verdicts that the available information cannot support.
blocks.zh:
对8个模型的评价表明,经常无法查明完整的缺陷。
GPT-6 Astra是缺陷F1上最强的型号,得分只有47.8%,并且只在34.3%的缺陷物品中识别出每个缺陷.
它未能对齐68.6%有缺陷的上下文链接.
模型也倾向于产生比人类更相近的相接,将不同的数学对象和缺失的关键相通.
当非正式的上下文和假设被扣时,最好的模型只承认28.2%的不可计量项目:模型往往给出明确的判断,认为现有信息不能支持.

blocks.en:
We summarize our contributions as follows: (1) We operationalize faithfulness evaluation as a context-aware align-then-label problem, linking informal and formal contents across targets, context, and assumptions while allowing undecidable judgments for underspecified inputs. (2) We create FaithAlign,
a heterogeneous benchmark with fine-grained correspondence annotations for evaluating defect and underspecification identification. (3) We empirically evaluate 8 models, revealing recurring failures to identify all defects, align contextual dependencies, and recognize undecidable cases.
blocks.zh:
我们的贡献总结如下: (1) 将忠实程度评价作为了解背景的、贴上标签的问题加以实施,将不同目标、背景和假设的非正式和正式内容联系起来,同时允许对未充分指明的投入作出不可更改的判断。 我们创造信仰,
a 各种基准,并附有细微的函证说明,用于评估缺陷和规格不足的识别。 (3)我们实证地评价了8个模型,揭示出反复出现的未能识别出所有缺陷,调和上下文的依赖性,并承认不可判定的案例.

blocks.en: 2 Illustrative Overview
blocks.zh: 2 说明性概述

blocks.en: Figure 1: A motivating example from Axler (2015) with the unfaithful formalization drawn from ProofNet ( Azerbayev et al., 2023 ) , and faithful one from ProofNet-Verified ( An et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 图1:Axler(2015年)的激励性实例,其中从ProofNet(Azerbayev等,2023年)和ProofNet-Verifed(An等,2026年)中取自不忠实的形式化。

blocks.en:
We illustrate the importance of faithful formalization with an example from ProofNet-Verified ( An et al., 2026 ) , shown in Figure 1 .
The natural language target proves a property over a vector space V V that is intended to hold over the real numbers ℝ \mathbb{R} and the complex numbers ℂ \mathbb{C} .
However, an unfaithful formalization found in the dataset instantiates the scalar field over ℂ \mathbb{C} , while omitting ℝ \mathbb{R} . The faithful formalization, on the other hand, correctly introduces {F} [RCLike F] , which quantifies over both ℝ \mathbb{R} and ℂ \mathbb{C} and is thereby faithful. Though relatively small, at the theory scale this error compounds if later theorems refer to this one in the dependency graph. In that case, the error propagates to downstream items, rendering entire sections of the overall theory unusable.
blocks.zh:
我们以图1所示的证明网络验证(An等人,2026年)的例子来说明忠实正规化的重要性。
自然语言目标在矢量空间V V 上证明了一个属性,该属性意在持有真实数字R\mathb{R}和复杂数字C\mathb{C}.
然而,在数据集中发现的不忠实形式化会将 C\ mathb{C} 上的 scalar 字段进行即时化,同时省略 R\ mathb{R}. 另一方面,忠实的正规化正确地引入了{F}[RC Like F],这在R\mathb{R}和C\mathb{C}上都量化,因此是忠实的. 虽然相对较小,但理论上如果以后的定理在依赖图中提及这个定理的话,这个误差的分级就会相加. 在这种情况下,错误传播到下游物品,使整个理论的整个部分无法使用。

blocks.en:
The example also reveals why such judgments are difficult.
Taken in isolation, the natural language target is immensely under-specified: the symbols V V and ℒ ⁡ ( V ) \mathcal{L}(V) are not defined in the natural language target. Further, even if we know that V V is a vector space, the target does not specify over which field it is defined. Such ambiguities cause both models and human annotators to output incorrect faithfulness labels. In this particular example, the unfaithful formalization is the ground truth released with ProofNet ( Azerbayev et al., 2023 ) , which the expert annotators of ProofNet-Verified ( An et al., 2026 ) later judged unfaithful and corrected to the faithful version shown here. The fact that a formalization accepted in one expert-curated benchmark was flagged as defective in another shows how easily these ambiguities slip past human review. To address this ambiguity gap, careful annotation is required to identify relevant context outside the natural language target. Doing so foregrounds these gaps, making explicit how ambiguities are resolved, rather than asserting that the target is unambiguous.
blocks.zh:
这个例子还揭示了为什么这种判决很困难。
孤立地取而代之的是,自然语言目标极不充分:符号V V和L Q (V)\ mathcal{L}(V)在自然语言目标中没有定义. 此外,即使我们知道V V是一个向量空间,目标也没有指定它被定义的字段. 这种模糊性导致模型和人文注释者都投出不正确的忠诚标签. 在这个特别的例子中,不忠实的形式化是用"ProofNet"(Azerbayev等,2023年)发布的基础真相,而"ProofNet-Verified"(An等,2026年)的专家注释者后来判断不忠实,并更正为此处所显示的忠实版本. 在一个专家确定的基准中接受的正规化在另一个基准中被标为有缺陷的事实表明,这些含糊之处很容易使人类审查失败。 为了解决这一模糊性差距,需要谨慎的注释,以确定自然语言目标以外的相关背景。 这样做预示了这些差距,明确了模糊之处是如何解决的,而不是断言目标明确。

To illustrate the importance of context, Figure 1 shows various natural language contexts ( C N C_{N} ) that appear earlier in the book: for example how F F denotes ℝ \mathbb{R} or ℂ \mathbb{C} ( C N ​ [ 1 ] C_{N}[1] ), and what the notation ℒ ⁡ ( V ) \mathcal{L}(V) ( C N ​ [ 2 ] C_{N}[2] ) means. We further require explicit mappings between phrase-level segments to show precisely where the formalization is faithful or not. For instance, the link from C N ​ [ 1 ] C_{N}[1] to the formal target [InnerProductSpace ℂ \mathbb{C} V] [FiniteDimensional ℂ \mathbb{C} V] ( T F ​ [ 2 ] T_{F}[2] ) shows precisely that T F ​ [ 2 ] T_{F}[2] is unfaithful (because it is missing ℝ \mathbb{R} ), and that the link to RCLike F is faithful. blocks.en: 3 Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3 问题表述

blocks.en:
In Section 2 , we demonstrated that a faithfulness judgment depends on context beyond the target statement and is most useful when it locates each discrepancy.
Motivated by this observation, we formulate faithfulness evaluation as a novel align-then-label problem in which the evaluator aligns informal text with Lean code and then labels each resulting link using the context that determines the meaning of both statements. We first specify the inputs to this process, including the targets, their surrounding context, and any implicit assumptions. Figure 4 summarizes the notation.
blocks.zh:
在第2节中,我们表明,忠诚的判断取决于目标声明以外的背景,在发现每个差异时最有用。
本着这一看法,我们提出忠诚评价,作为一个新颖的对齐和标签问题,其中评价人员将非正式文本与Lean代码相统一,然后利用决定两种语句含义的上下文对每个由此产生的链接进行标签。 我们首先具体说明对这一进程的投入,包括目标、其周围背景以及任何隐含的假设。 图4汇总了注解。

blocks.en: 3.1 Inputs
blocks.zh: 3.1 投入

blocks.en:
As Figure 1 shows, the same statement can admit different interpretations when read in isolation.
Each item therefore pairs the informal and formal targets with the context that sufficiently disambiguates their respective meanings. We distinguish context available from the natural language source from context available from the formalization, and separately represent assumptions needed to resolve ambiguities that neither source makes explicit.
blocks.zh:
如图1所显示,当单独阅读时,同一语句可以接受不同的解释.
因此,每个项目将非正式和正式目标与充分混淆其各自含义的背景联系起来。 我们区分了现有背景和自然语言来源与形式化的背景,并分别代表了解决两个来源都未明确说明的模糊性所需的假设。

blocks.en:
The informal target T N T_{N} is the statement to be formalized, and the formal target T F T_{F} is its Lean formalization ( de Moura & Ullrich, 2021 ) .
The informal context C N C_{N} quotes the definitions, notation, and standing assumptions that T N T_{N} relies on.
The formal context C F C_{F} lists the declarations that T F T_{F} references, such as Mathlib definitions ( The mathlib Community, 2020 ) .
Where the source leaves an interpretive choice open, such as an unstated convention, the implicit assumptions I I state it explicitly.

如果来源没有作出解释性选择,例如未说明的公约,我就要明确指出隐含的假设。

blocks.en: 3.2 Labeled Alignments
blocks.zh: 3.2 标签对齐

blocks.en:
Regions and links. To tie each judgment to the expressions responsible for it, an alignment is built from regions connected by links.
A region is a set of selected characters, which may consist of several disjoint spans.
A link pairs an informal region σ \sigma with a formal region τ \tau .
Because missing and extraneous conditions have no counterpart by definition, either endpoint may be empty, but not both.
A one-sided link ( σ , ∅ ) (\sigma,\varnothing) records informal material with no formal counterpart, and ( ∅ , τ ) (\varnothing,\tau) records formal material with no informal counterpart.
Regions may overlap and participate in several links.
To evaluate links involving context and assumptions separately from those between the targets, we assign each link a role by its endpoints.
A link is implicit if an endpoint lies in I I , context if it has no endpoint in I I but one in C N C_{N} or C F C_{F} , and target otherwise.
blocks.zh:
区域和联系。 为了将每个判断与对此负责的表达式联系起来,从连接到链接的区域开始构建一个对齐.
一个区域是一组被选中的字符,其中可能包含几个脱节的跨度.

blocks.en: 4.1 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 4.1 基准建设

blocks.en:
Sources and target pairs. FaithAlign draws on five sources, namely LeanEuclid ( Murphy et al., 2024 ) , Pistis ( Mao et al., 2026 ) , MA-Align ( Patel et al., 2026 ) , LCS-Bench ( Feng et al., 2026 ) , and ProofNet-Verified ( An et al., 2026 ) .
For each source, we use the provided informal–formal pairs as targets and manually construct their contexts from their textbook sources ( Gallier, 2015 , e.g.,) .
Since Pistis refines LeanEuclid, we report the two as one group, LeanEuclid–Pistis.
blocks.zh:
源与目标对. FaithAlign利用了五个来源,即Lean Euclid(Murphy等,2024年),Pistis。 ("毛泽东等",2026)., MA-Align. (Patel等,2026年),LCS-Bench (Feng等,2026年),和证明 网-核查(An等,2026).
对于每个来源,我们使用所提供的非正式形式对作为目标,并用手动构建其教科书来源的背景(Gallier,2015等)。
由于皮斯提斯精炼出"利安-欧克利得"(Lean-Euclid-Pistis),我们将两者报告为一组.

blocks.en:
Context selection and annotation. Four graduate-level experts in Lean and mathematics, all with prior Lean research experience, annotated the benchmark over about eight person-months using a browser-based visual tool in three steps.
First, they select broad regions on the informal and formal sides, connect corresponding regions or mark counterparts as absent, and assign labels.
Second, for unfaithful links, they narrow the selected regions to isolate the misalignment.
Each unfaithful region is made as precise as possible while remaining coherent.
Third, they supply context for each mathematical object required to understand T N T_{N} and T F T_{F} .
On the informal side, this consists of complete source segments, such as paragraphs or book subsections, containing the relevant background.
Annotators also add assumptions to resolve ambiguity or underspecification left by the source context.
On the formal side, annotators gather the referenced declarations and other dependencies needed to understand the selected targets.
Context selection covers the mathematical dependencies of both targets.
A second annotator then reviews and refines every item, and the completed annotations retain 81.9% alignment-link overlap with the initial versions, counting labels, under the evaluation scorer.
blocks.zh:
上下文选择与注释. 4位精益和数学专业的研究生级专家,都具有之前的精益研究经验,在大约8个人月的时间里,利用一个基于浏览器的视觉工具,分出3个步骤对基准进行注释.
首先,它们选择非正式和正式方面的大区域,将相应区域连接起来或将对应区域标为缺席,并指定标签。
其次,对于不忠实的联系,他们缩小了选定的区域,以隔离错位.
每个不忠的区域尽可能精确,同时保持协调一致。
第三,它们为每个需要理解T N T_{N}和T F T_{F}的数学对象提供上下文.
在非正式方面,这包括完整的来源部分,如段落或书籍分节,包含相关的背景.
注释者还加入了一些假设,以解决源上下文留下的模糊或描述不足.
在正式方面,注释者收集参考宣言和了解选定目标所需的其他依赖。
背景选择涵盖两个目标的数学依赖性.
第二位注释员然后审查和细化了每个项目,完成的说明保留了81.9%的对齐-链接与初始版本相重叠,计数标签,在评分分符下.

blocks.en:
Constructing FaithAlign-Gap. FaithAlign-Gap tests whether evaluators recognize when the supplied material is insufficient to settle faithfulness.
Each item keeps the two targets and the formal context of a FaithAlign item but withholds C N C_{N} and I I . These items are annotated separately, with undecidable labels on links that depend on the withheld material.
The set contains undecidable items, whose targets admit readings with different faithfulness judgments without that material.
It also contains decidable controls that are unambiguous under common assumptions.
For each undecidable item, we also construct an opposite-verdict counterpart whose informal context reverses the verdict of the original item, forming a triplet of the undecidable item, its original item, and the counterpart.
blocks.zh:
构建 FaithAlign-Gap. FaithAlign-Gap 测试评估者是否识别所提供的材料是否不足以解决忠诚问题.
每一个项目都保留着两个目标, 这些项目分别作注释,对取决于被扣留材料的链接有不可识别的标签.
这套内容包含不可更改的项目,其目标接受不同忠实判断的读取,而没有这种材料.
它还包含根据共同假设明确无误的可决定的控制。
对于每个不可计量的项目,我们也构建出一个相反的对等项目,其非正式上下文颠倒了原项目的判决,形成了不可计量项目,其原始项目,和对等项目的三进制.

blocks.en:
FaithAlign contains 460 full-context items, with 164 faithful and 296 unfaithful whole-item verdicts.
Its 4,982 annotated links, 4,232 faithful and 750 unfaithful, range from 2 to 34 per item, and 25.5% of them involve context or assumptions.
Figure 6 summarizes source composition and input lengths for LCS-Bench (LCS), ProofNet-Verified (PN-V), MA-Align (MA), and LeanEuclid–Pistis (LE-P), and Figure 6 summarizes endpoint types and links per item.
FaithAlign-Gap is counted separately and contains 146 items, of which 85 are undecidable, 12 faithful, and 49 unfaithful.
Its 1,481 links are 954 faithful, 103 unfaithful, and 424 undecidable ones, and the Appendix gives its composition.

它的4,982个注释链接,4,232个忠实和750个不忠实,每个项目从2个到34个不等,其中25.5%涉及上下文或假设.

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation Tasks and Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.3 评价任务和协议

blocks.en:
We evaluate models on two align-then-label tasks, which differ in whether the context that fixes the interpretation is supplied.
In both tasks, the model returns a labeled alignment rather than a verdict, and the item verdict is inferred from its findings by the rule in Section 3.2 .
Both tasks are scored with the metrics defined in Section 3.3 , and the FaithAlign-Gap triplets connect them by pairing each undecidable item with full-context versions of both readings.
blocks.zh:
我们评价两个对齐和标签任务的模型,这些模型在是否提供了确定解释的上下文方面有所不同。
在这两个任务中,模型返回一个被标注的对接,而不是一个判断,项目判断是根据第3.2.节中的规则从其结论推断出来的.
两项任务都用第3.3节所定义的度量衡来打分,而FaithAlign-Gap三重奏则通过将每个不可更改的项目与两个读取的完整文本版本相配来连接.

blocks.en:
Full-context alignment. This task measures recovery of both faithful links and defects under a fixed interpretation.
On the 460 FaithAlign items, the model receives all five input components of Section 3.1 and labels each link faithful or unfaithful.
Each nonempty endpoint is a set of character spans from the targets, from the context, or from a single assumption.
The alignment also requires unmatched material.
An acceptable omission or addition therefore forms a faithful one-sided link, and a required condition missing from the formalization, including one stated only in the context, forms an unfaithful link with an empty formal endpoint.
Context is selected only where it supplies the material being assessed or fixes the interpretation of a link.
The model is instructed to align coherent mathematical contributions, such as the setup, hypotheses, and conclusion, rather than individual symbols, and to split a contribution that contains separable faithful and defective parts.
We report defect F1, together with defect F1@0.5, joint F1, and the all-defects rate.
blocks.zh:
全文对齐. 这项任务在固定解释下衡量对忠实联系和缺陷的恢复。
在460 FaithAlign项目上,该模型接收了第3.1节的所有5个输入组件,并给每个链接的忠实或不忠实标记.
每一个非空的终点都是一组字符从目标,上下文,或从单一的假设来跨出.
校正还需要无与伦比的材料。
因此,可接受的遗漏或添加构成一个忠实的片面联系,正式化中缺少一个必要条件,包括仅在上下文中说明的一个条件,构成与一个空正式终点的不忠实联系。
只有在提供评估的材料或确定联系的解释时才选择背景。
该模型被指示调整一致的数学贡献,如设置,假设,和结论,而不是单个符号,并分出一个包含可分离的忠实和有缺陷部分的贡献.
我们报告缺陷F1,以及缺陷F1@0.5,联合F1和所有缺陷率。

blocks.en:
Context-omitted alignment. This task measures whether the model recognizes when the supplied material cannot settle faithfulness.
On the 146 FaithAlign-Gap items, the model receives only T N T_{N} , T F T_{F} , and C F C_{F} and may additionally label a link undecidable.
An undecidable link connects the visible informal phrase whose interpretation is unresolved with the formal material whose faithfulness depends on it.
Undecidable items and decidable controls use the same prompt, which does not reveal which kind an item is, so the model must itself determine whether the supplied material settles each link.
We report undecidable-link F1, the undecidable-item rate, and verdict accuracy over all 146 items, split into undecidable items and decidable controls.
On the 85 triplets, comparing each undecidable item with its two full-context versions separates recognition of underspecification from correct judgment once the missing context is supplied; we therefore report verdict accuracy for both the context-omitted and full-context versions.
blocks.zh:
上下文允许对齐。 这项任务衡量模型是否承认所提供的材料不能解决忠诚问题。
在146 FaithAlign-Gap项目上,该模型只接收了T N T_{N},TF T_{F}和CF C_{F},并可能额外给一个链接贴上不可识别标签.
一个不可识别的链接将醒目的非正式短语连接起来,其解释尚未解决,而其忠实性取决于其正式材料.
不可识别项目和可识别控件使用相同的快取,不能显示项目是哪一种,所以模型本身必须确定所提供的材料是否结算了每个链接.
我们报告无法解析的链接 F1,不可解析的项目率,以及所有146项的判定准确性,分为不可解析的项目和可解析的控制.
在85个三进制上,将每个不可计量项目与其两个完整文本版本相比,一旦提供了缺失的上下文,便将识别规格不足与正确判断分开;因此,我们报告上下文和完整文本版本的判决准确性。

blocks.en:
We evaluate 8 models on the tasks in Section 4.3 , with a 32,768-token output limit.
The models are GPT-6 Astra (GPT6), GPT-5.6 Sol (GPT56), Kimi K3 (KK3), Opus 5 (CO5), Opus 4.8 (CO48), DeepSeek V3.2 (DS32), GLM-5 (GLM5), and MiniMax M2.5 (MM25).
The evaluation covers all 460 FaithAlign items and all 146 FaithAlign-Gap items, with three repetitions of full-context and context-omitted alignment per model.
Figures report means with sample standard deviations.
Alignment tasks provide text-search and answer-validation tools, with no mathematical correctness feedback.
Scoring details are provided in the Appendix.

blocks.en:
RQ1: Can models identify faithfulness defects? Models rarely find all the defects in an item, and most of the defects they miss are never aligned at all.
Figure 8 shows that in full-context alignment, even the strongest model, GPT-6 Astra, reaches a defect F1 of only 47.8%, and its score drops further under the stricter F1@0.5.
Whole-item verdicts would hide this gap.
Astra’s inferred verdicts reach 93.1% balanced accuracy, averaging its accuracy on faithful and unfaithful items, although it identifies every defect in only 34.3% of defective items.
As Figure 8 shows, this rate falls to 4.5% on items with two or more defects.
On two-defect items, Astra finds exactly one defect in 68% of cases, against 48% under independent detection at the same per-defect rate, so it finds both far less often than independence predicts.
Figure 9(a) attributes most failures to defects that are never aligned rather than to defects aligned but wrongly labeled, so the bottleneck lies mainly in locating defects rather than in judging them.
These omissions persist across attempts, since on average nearly two thirds of defects are never identified in any of the three repetitions.
blocks.zh:
RQ1:模型能否识别出忠诚缺陷? 模型很少发现某一项中的所有缺陷,他们错过的大部分缺陷从来就没有对齐过.
图8显示,在全文本对接中,即使是最强的模型GPT-6 Astra也只达到47.8%的缺陷F1,其得分在更严格的F1@0.5下进一步下降.
整个项目的裁决会掩盖这一差距。
Astra的推断结论达到了93.1%的平衡准确度,平均精确度为忠实和不忠实项目,尽管它只找出34.3%的缺陷项目。
如图8所示,有两种或两种以上缺陷的物品的这一比率降至4.5%。
在两件小事上 Astra在68%的病例中发现一个缺陷,而48%的病例在独立检测中,每个缺陷率相同,因此发现两者都比独立预测的少得多。
图9(a)将大多数失败归因于从未对齐的缺陷,而不是被对齐但标签错误的缺陷,因此瓶颈主要在于找出缺陷,而不是判断缺陷。
这些遗漏在各种尝试中持续存在,因为在三次重复中,平均有近三分之二的缺陷从未被发现。

blocks.en:
RQ2: How well do models identify and assess contextual links? Models often fail to connect the targets to the context they depend on, so most contextual defects go unassessed.
Figure 11(a) shows that links involving context have the lowest joint F1 of all link roles, 15.7 percentage points below the overall score.
The deficit comes mostly from missing links, since roughly three quarters of contextual defects are never aligned, and defects involving implicit assumptions are omitted in much the same way.
Supplying the surrounding material therefore does not ensure that a model uses it, which is a central failure for theory-scale assessment.
blocks.zh:
RQ2:模型如何识别和评估背景联系? 模型往往无法将目标与所依赖的上下文联系起来,所以大多数上下文的缺陷都得不到评估.
图11(a)显示,涉及上下文的链接在所有链接角色中联合F1的比例最低,比总分低15.7个百分点.
缺陷主要来自缺失环节,因为大约四分之三的上下文缺陷从未对齐,涉及隐含假设的缺陷也以大致相同的方式被省去.
因此,提供周围的材料不能确保模型使用,这是理论尺度评估的中心失败.

blocks.en:
RQ3: Can models recognize underspecification when relevant context is absent? Models seldom recognize that missing context leaves a judgment open, and instead commit to one reading.
Figure 13 shows that in context-omitted alignment, most correct verdicts come from the decidable controls, while every model struggles to identify the undecidable items.
A definite verdict on an undecidable item could stem from two different failures, misjudging the item or not noticing that its judgment depends on the withheld context.
The paired comparison separates the two by stating each reading explicitly.
In full-context alignment, where the supplied context fixes the interpretation, Astra judges both the faithful and the unfaithful version correctly in 96.9% of triplets, as Table 13 shows, so it can judge each reading once that reading is stated.
In context-omitted alignment, however, it usually supplies an unstated assumption of its own, and for 52 of the 85 triplets it judges both versions correctly yet gives a definite verdict in every repetition.
The failure therefore lies in recognizing that a judgment depends on context the model has not been given.
blocks.zh:
RQ3:当缺少相关上下文时,模型能否识别出不够具体化? 模型很少承认缺失上下文留下了判断余地,而是承诺只读一次。
图13显示,在上下文允许的对齐中,大多数正确的判断来自可解密控制,而每个模型都为识别不可解密的项目而挣扎.
对无法断定的项目作出明确裁决可能来自两个不同的失败,即错误判断项目,或没有注意到其判决取决于所扣上的背景。
配对比较通过明确说明每次读取来区分两者.
如表13所示,Astra在全文校正中,在所提供的上下文确定解释时,在96.9%的三胞胎中正确判断了忠实和不忠实的版本,因此,一旦说明读取内容,就可以判断每个读取内容。
但是,在上下文允许的调整中,它通常提供自己未说明的假设,对于85个三进制中的52个,它正确地判断了这两个版本,但每次重复都作出明确的判决。
因此,失败在于承认判断取决于没有给出模型的背景。

blocks.en:
RQ4: Can models produce fine-grained mathematical alignments? Current models cannot yet produce alignments at the granularity of the annotations, and most annotated links receive no matching prediction.
As Figure 10 shows, in full-context alignment the number of predicted links grows much more slowly than the number of annotated links, and roughly 60% of annotated links remain unaligned on average.
Figure 9(b) separates two kinds of failure behind these gaps.
About a third on average are overmerged links , in which a single prediction spans several annotated links and collapses their separate mathematical relationships into one label.
In the rest, models omit one or both endpoints, or select both endpoints in separate links without connecting them.
blocks.zh:
RQ4:模型能否产生精细的数学对齐? 目前的模型尚不能在说明的颗粒性产生对齐,大多数被注释的链接都得不到匹配的预测.
如图10所显示的,在全文校正中,预测的链接数量比注释链接数量增长得慢得多,约60%的注释链接平均仍未对齐.
图9(b)对这些差距背后的两种失败进行了区分。
平均约有三分之一的链接被过度地叠加,其中单一的预测跨越了几个附加注释的链接,并将它们单独的数学关系崩溃成一个标签.
在其余部分,模型会省略一个或两个端点,或者在单独的链接中选择两个端点而不连接.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We formulated theory-scale faithfulness evaluation as a context-aware align-then-label problem and introduced FaithAlign and FaithAlign-Gap to evaluate defect identification and recognition of underspecification.
Models frequently miss defects, overlook contextual links, and give definite judgments when essential information is absent.
These findings highlight detailed alignment and reasoning about contextual dependencies as central challenges for reliable faithfulness assessment.
Future work should develop evaluators that systematically trace dependencies, search for additional defects, and identify the missing definitions or assumptions needed to resolve undecidable judgments.
blocks.zh:
我们制定了理论规模的忠诚度评价,作为了解背景的对齐-当时的标签问题,并引入了FaithAlign和FaithAlign-Gap来评价缺陷的识别和对缺陷的识别.
模型常常漏掉了缺陷,忽略了上下文的联系,并在缺少基本信息时作出明确的判断。
这些结论突出强调了对背景依赖性的详细调整和推理,这是可靠的可靠性评估的核心挑战。
今后的工作应当培养评价人员,系统地追踪依赖性,寻找其他缺陷,并找出解决无法确定的判断所需的缺失定义或假设。

Formulating and proving mathematical claims and qualitative data analysis do not apply to this work.
AI-assisted drafts and figures were revised through iterative author review, and reported numerical summaries were checked against saved experimental results.

blocks.en: A.4 Annotation Process
blocks.zh: A.4 注释程序

blocks.en:
Each item passes through two expert annotators.
The four annotators are graduate-level experts in Lean and mathematics with prior experience in Lean research, and the annotation took about eight person-months.
One annotator constructs an item through the three steps in Section 4.1 , and a second annotator then reviews and refines it.
Under the scorer used for model evaluation, the completed annotations retain 93.5% span overlap and 89.5% alignment-link overlap with the initial versions, so review refines the annotations rather than rewriting them.
This review covers every FaithAlign item, every FaithAlign-Gap item, and every opposite-verdict counterpart.
blocks.zh:
每件物品都经过两个专家注释员。
这4名注释员都是精益和数学的研究生级专家,之前在精益研究方面有经验,注释用了大约8个人月.
一名注释员通过第4.1节的三个步骤构筑出一个项目,另一名注释员再加以审查和完善。
在用于模型评价的分数器下,所完成的说明保留了93.5%的跨度重叠和89.5%的对齐链接与初始版本相重叠,因此审查完善了说明而不是重写.
本次审查涵盖了FaithAlign项目,FaithAlign-Gap项目,以及每个相反的对等项目.

blocks.en:
Generative AI assisted only with span proposals for the MA-Align items.
Codex and Claude Code proposed candidate spans for these items, and an annotator refined every proposed span.
No other annotation step used generative AI.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en:
The AI-proposed spans show no sign of favoring the evaluated GPT and Claude models.
Codex and Claude Code run GPT and Claude models, and four of the eight evaluated models are GPT or Claude models.
On MA-Align, the only source with AI-proposed spans, these four models reach on average 70% of their joint F1 on the other three sources, the same proportion as the other four models (Table 13 ).
Their defect F1 proportions also fall within the range of the other four models.

blocks.en:
Scored mathematical content. We trim import and scope commands, theorem/lemma title prefixes, and sorry proof placeholders from predicted and reference formal endpoints.
Mixed selections retain their mathematical spans and labels.
If trimming empties a formal endpoint, a remaining informal endpoint forms a one-sided link; a finding with neither endpoint remaining is removed.
In the selected-region task, formal regions consisting entirely of these spans and their incident predictions are omitted from scoring.
Whole-item verdicts inferred from alignments use the retained findings.
This preprocessing leaves 4,768 full-context reference links and 1,443 FaithAlign-Gap reference links.

blocks.en:
Identification of every defect. The All defects score uses the 296 full-context items containing at least one annotated unfaithful link.
An item succeeds when every unfaithful link has a matched prediction labeled unfaithful under the standard label-blind assignment.
Each match requires positive overlap at every nonempty endpoint and agreement on empty endpoints.
The score measures complete defect recall at the item level; additional predictions are assessed by defect F1.
Figure 8 reports this rate separately for items with one, two, and at least three defects, using each group’s item count as its denominator.

Verdict accuracy and undecidable-item rate. Verdicts are inferred from the retained predicted findings: unfaithful if any finding is labeled unfaithful, otherwise undecidable if any finding is labeled undecidable, and faithful otherwise.
Verdict accuracy compares this verdict with the annotated verdict over a given item set.
Balanced verdict accuracy averages verdict accuracy over faithful and unfaithful items, and for GPT-6 Astra under full-context alignment it is 93.1% on average over the three repetitions.
The undecidable-item rate uses the 85 undecidable FaithAlign-Gap items, so an item succeeds only when no finding is labeled unfaithful and at least one is labeled undecidable.

blocks.en: C.5 Selected-region Counterpart Identification
blocks.zh: C.5 选定区域对口识别

blocks.en:
This task supplies a region selected from one target and asks the model to identify all its counterparts and label each resulting link.
We evaluate both directions: informal-target regions mapped to formal regions, and formal-target regions mapped to informal regions.
The complete context remains available, and counterparts may lie in either targets or context.
A selected region can have multiple counterparts; an empty counterpart records unmatched material.
Supplying one endpoint isolates counterpart identification and labeling from the initial selection of a region.
blocks.zh:
这项任务提供从一个目标中选定的区域,并要求该模式确定所有对应方,并给每个由此产生的链接贴上标签。
我们评价两个方向:将非正式目标区域划入正式区域,将正式目标区域划入非正式区域。
完整的情况依然存在,对应方可能要么是目标,要么是背景。
一个被选中的区域可以有多个对应方;一个空对应方记录没有匹配的材料.
提供一端点将对应方识别和标签从一个区域的初始选择中分离出来.

blocks.en:
Fixing the region of interest still leaves substantial difficulty identifying its complete counterpart set.
Only 24.7% of selected regions have the exact complete counterpart set, including its boundaries.
The outputs omit counterparts or select their boundaries imprecisely, and defect F1 averages 32.4% (Table 12 ).
blocks.zh:

只有24.7%的选定地区有精确的完整对应系统,包括其边界。

blocks.en: D.1 Shared Full-context Instructions
blocks.zh: D.1 共用全文说明

blocks.en: ⬇ Assess whether the supplied Lean formalization faithfully represents the natural - language specification , interpreted using its complete source context , formal context , and declared implicit assumptions . All supplied documents are available for every task . Preserve the stated mathematical objects , hypotheses , constructions , and relationships . Faithfulness concerns representation , independently of whether the statement is true or its proof succeeds . Use label 1 for a faithful correspondence or an acceptable unmatched mathematical contribution . Use label 0 for a faithfulness defect , including a missing required contribution or an unsupported added restriction . For alignment tasks , first group coherent mathematical contributions in the two targets and match direct correspondences . Judge these directly ; refine a group when it has clearly separable faithful and defective contributions . Then use context for unmatched contributions or interpretations that require it . Read the actual supplied definitions when their meaning matters . Keep shared object introductions together and complete inference rules together . Avoid independent links for every repeated variable use . Separate setup , hypotheses , and conclusion when they are clearly distinct contributions . A link relates one natural - language contribution to one formal contribution . Each endpoint selects exactly one kind of region : target , context , or assumption . Several discontinuous pieces may jointly express one contribution , including pieces from multiple context documents of the same side . Never mix target , context , and assumption kinds within one endpoint . An assumption endpoint selects exactly one whole assumption document . Either endpoint may be null , but both cannot be null . Select precise context passages when they supply the contribution being assessed or establish an interpretation required for that link . Supporting reading material may remain unselected . A required source - context condition or assumption missing from the formalization is linked to a null formal endpoint with label 0. Do not select broad context merely because it is available . Full alignment includes meaningful faithful correspondences and meaningful unmatched mathematical contributions , with an empty counterpart and their own label . Preserve meaningful binders , hypotheses , definitions , typeclass inputs , and logical relationships . An acceptable omission or addition has label 1. Defect - only alignment includes only label 0 links . Use selective annotation . Presentation - only material , whitespace , noncontributing punctuation , import and scope commands , routine theorem titles , and proof placeholders may remain unselected . Do not add links just to cover characters . Meaningful extras still belong in full alignment . Spans use zero - based Unicode codepoint offsets and half - open intervals [ start , end ). Use find_text to obtain exact spans . Before submitting , call validate_answer with the complete proposed JSON string . Correct structural or coordinate errors and validate again . blocks.en: ⬇ Assess whether the supplied Lean formalization faithfully represents the natural - language specification . Documents with side N give the natural - language target and any supplied source context or assumptions . Documents with side L give the formal target and formal context . Use all supplied documents and ordinary mathematical and Lean knowledge . Read the definitions used by the formal target when their content affects the comparison . Faithfulness concerns whether the objects , hypotheses , constructions , and relationships are represented correctly , independently of whether the mathematical statement is true or its proof succeeds . Use these verdict definitions : - faithful : the supplied information establishes a faithful representation of the specification . - unfaithful : the supplied information establishes a faithfulness defect , such as a missing requirement , an unsupported restriction , or a mismatch in a used definition . - not_decidable : the supplied source specification leaves a substantive interpretive choice unresolved , and reasonable interpretations consistent with the visible wording yield different faithfulness judgments for the fixed formalization . Use not_decidable for insufficient specification , not for unfamiliar syntax , lack of confidence , or an unproved theorem . Do not invent arbitrary redefinitions or vacuous assumptions . An established defect makes the whole item unfaithful even if another part has an unresolved interpretation . Construct a complete alignment between the supplied natural - language specification and Lean formalization . Apply the verdict definitions to each mathematical contribution , assigning one label per link : 1 for faithful , 0 for unfaithful , and 2 for not_decidable . An acceptable unmatched contribution receives label 1. Label every distinct source of undecidability that you identify , while also aligning contributions whose faithfulness is decidable . First match coherent mathematical contributions in the two targets . Keep shared object introductions and complete inference rules together . Separate setup , hypotheses , defining conditions , and conclusions when they express distinct contributions . Refine a group when clearly separable contributions have different labels . Avoid separate links for every repeated variable use . When a contribution depends on a formal definition , inspect that definition and select the precise formal passage that explains the correspondence , defect , or unresolved interpretation . For label 2, select the visible source phrase whose interpretation is unresolved and the formal contribution whose faithfulness depends on it . If an endpoint has no corresponding visible contribution , use null . Do not flag an entire theorem or definition when a more precise range identifies the issue . Each N endpoint is a nonempty list of natural - language spans or null . Each L endpoint is a nonempty list of formal - target spans or formal - context spans , or null ; do not mix target and context within one endpoint . Discontinuous pieces may jointly express one contribution . Both endpoints cannot be null . Include meaningful unmatched mathematical contributions with their own label . Routine names , imports , scope commands , punctuation , and proof placeholders may remain unselected . Spans use zero - based Unicode codepoint offsets and half - open intervals [ start , end ). Use find_text to locate exact spans in the supplied documents . Before submitting , call validate_answer with the complete proposed JSON string and correct structural or coordinate errors . This tool gives no mathematical correctness feedback . Return only this JSON structure , with integer labels 0, 1, or 2 and no explanations or Markdown fences : {" findings ":[{" N ":[[" N0 ",0,10]]," L ":[[" L0 ",20,30]]," y ":1}]}

blocks.en:
The user message is the item’s document packet serialized as JSON with two-space indentation.
For full-context and context-omitted alignment, its top-level field is documents .
Each document supplies its id , side ( N or L ), role ( target , context , or assumption ), and complete text .
Context-omitted packets contain the two targets and formal context.
Selected-region tasks additionally supply an anchors array; each anchor has an id , its spans , and a text array containing the selected text of each span.
All spans use [document_id, start, end] with zero-based Unicode-codepoint offsets and half-open intervals.
Reference counterparts and labels are withheld.
